title: Tôi sạc điện thoại ở đây được không?
englishTitle: Can I charge my phone here?
pronunciation: toy sahk dyen thoai uh day dook khong
summary: Different ways to say "Can I charge my phone here?" in Vietnam, with the phrase to start with, reusable pieces, and related next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use this when the place has power and you need permission or a spot to charge. This works in cafés, hotels, airports, and waiting areas. After the first answer, the related phrases help you handle the likely follow-up without starting over.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: This pattern turns the phrase into a yes-or-no question. Keep the main need together so the question stays natural.

sections.body: Tôi sạc điện thoại ở đây được không? is the version to learn first for "Can I charge my phone here?". Use this when the place has power and you need permission or a spot to charge. Show the phone screen or error message first so the problem is visible before you add more words.

sections.body: Show the screen first and keep control of your phone unless the situation feels trustworthy.

sections.title: Local tip
sections.body: Show the phone screen while you speak. A visible error message often explains the problem faster than more words.
